title: How do guests reach Ashaeiynn, and what is the best mode of transport?

segments.text: Arriving Directly in Hisar (By Flight or Train) ​Local Auto or Cab: If you land at Hisar airport or alight at Hisar railway station, take a direct auto-rickshaw or taxi. ​Landmark & Route for Drivers: Local drivers may not know Aashayein by name yet. Ask the driver to take you to Hotel Green Beach, located on the outskirts of Hisar, beyond Gangwa near the bypass. ​Specific Directions: Tell the driver that it is on the same road as the Jio Petrol Pump. Go straight past the Jio Petrol Pump for about 2 km, and the hotel will be on the left side near the end of flyover. ​Estimated Fare: An auto or cab from Hisar city/station/bus stand to Hotel Green Beach typically costs around ₹200 – ₹250. ​Arriving via Delhi (By Flight or Train) ​Direct Cab: You can hail or book a direct cab from Delhi (airport, station, or city) straight to Ashaeiynn. ​By Bus (Kashmiri Gate): ​Head to Kashmiri Gate ISBT in Delhi, where plenty of AC buses operate frequently toward Hisar (private operators like Krishna Travels are widely available). ​Take a bus to the Hisar City Bus depot. ​From the Hisar bus depot, take an auto-rickshaw directly to Hotel Green Beach beyond Gangwa using the landmark instructions above. ​Safety Precautions for Traveling Guests ​Live Location & Tracking: For your safety while commuting by auto, cab, or bus, always keep your device location turned on and track your ride/route on GPS as you travel. ​Share Trip Status: Share your live location or trip details with family or friends so someone is always aware of your progress.
